description: Animate one sprite into a single 16-frame clip from a description of the motion. For several clips (walk + run + attack, or every direction) use generate_animation_set instead: one job, 15 credits per clip. 15 credits.

end_frame.description: Optional image for the clip to end on: an image key from any of your assets (get_asset lists them), or its cdn.voidless.dev URL, e.g. the start image to loop, or another sprite's pose. Empty = free ending. An end image of another size is scaled to the start image's; one of a very different shape is refused (nothing charged)

frameId.description: Optional: the frame the new frames hang under in the editor (usually the frame referenceFile came from).

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

prompt.description: The motion, e.g. 'walk cycle', 'swings sword overhead'

referenceFile.description: Work from one image instead of the asset's base: an image key from any of your assets (as get_asset lists it), or its cdn.voidless.dev URL. Empty = the asset's current base image.

name: animate_sprite
